title: Lake Registry entry v1 (canonical lake IDENTITY)
description: LAKE REGISTRY (Platform-owned): canonical lake identity only. Lake Brain owns intelligence ABOUT lakes (hydrology, bindings, condition interpretation, species presence). Per-lake species presence and private observations never belong here or in public Git. Phase 1A defines the shape only; no registry data is migrated.

geometryManifestRef.description: Pointer (URI/version/hash) to released geometry; geometry itself is not embedded.

lakeKey.description: Stable derived key (lake_key); derivation owned by the registry and covered by conformance fixtures.
